measurement_rules: These are proposed engineering budgets, not expected or observed performance.
All prerequisites and gates are conjunctive; unapproved or unmeasured gates have no decision.
End-to-end includes catalog, prompt construction, model generation, Rust validation, SPARQL and evidence.
Cold first answer includes process and model startup; record cached versus uncached asset conditions.
Report p50/p95/p99, sample counts, retries, failures, timeouts, per-family results and 95% uncertainty intervals.
A zero-error small sample is not proof of a zero population error rate.
Exact answer accuracy uses all supported questions as denominator, including false abstentions and execution failures.
Wrong-plan execution and unflagged user-facing wrong-plan answers are distinct metrics; report both.
Define human semantic adjudication and conservative structural-equality treatment before the holdout.
If quality or CPU gates fail, revise scope/model or require confirmation and retest on an independent holdout.
Stop the current experiment immediately for an authorization boundary failure; repair and rerun deterministic tests first.
A stop-for-free-form-Ask decision requires documented failed revisions or inability to meet the approved constraints; Find remains separate.
